key.text: A small night light for my dorm desk with a warm LED inside and a 3D printed cover. Just one, about the size of my palm.

output.summary: A small 3D printed night light with a warm LED inside for a dorm desk.

needs.why: To print the outer cover of the night light.
To add a warm LED and circuit inside.

routes.process: 3D print the cover and assemble a small circuit inside
routes.fit_reason: This space lets you use 3D printing and small electronic components directly. It is a good fit for a beginner making a palm-sized light.

steps.title: Design the piece
steps.detail: Create a palm-sized hollow cover design for your night light.

steps.title: Check sizes
steps.detail: Check that your design fits within the build area of the 3D printer.

steps.title: Ask staff for help
steps.detail: Email the lab at lvy@usc.edu to ask what you can use and when.

steps.title: Assemble and finish
steps.detail: Place the warm LED circuit inside the printed cover.

warnings.issue: The cover walls may be too thin if made less than a tenth of an inch thick.
warnings.fix: Make the walls thicker in your design file.

routes.process: Submit a 3D print work order and use the electronics bench
routes.fit_reason: Staff print the part for you, which is great for beginners. You can then solder and test the electronics at the bench.

steps.title: Design the piece

warnings.fix: Complete the required safety training levels first.
